blocks.en: Notice on Misconduct in Course Registration
blocks.ko: 수강신청 부정행위 관련 알림

blocks.en: □ Related University Rules and Regulations
blocks.ko: □ 관련 학칙 및 규정

blocks.en: ❍ 「Seoul National University Rules」 Article 107 (Disciplinary Action)
blocks.ko: ❍ 「서울대학교 학칙」 제107조(징계)

blocks.en: ① The President may take disciplinary action against a student who violates these Rules or acts in a way that goes against a student's duties.
blocks.ko: ① 총장은 학생이 이 학칙을 위반하거나 학생의 본분에 어긋난 행위를 하였을 때에는 징계할 수 있다.

blocks.en: ❍ 「Seoul National University Student Disciplinary Regulations」 Article 3 (Grounds for Disciplinary Action)
blocks.ko: ❍ 「서울대학교 학생 징계 규정」 제3조(징계사유)

blocks.en: The President takes disciplinary action against any person who falls under any of the following items, based on the result of the disciplinary review and decision.
blocks.ko: 총장은 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사람을 징계 심의·의결의 결과에 따라 징계한다.

blocks.en: 1. A person who commits misconduct (cheating) related to studies
blocks.ko: 1. 학업과 관련하여 부정행위를 한 사람

blocks.en: 2. A person who disrupts classes or the work of academic administration
blocks.ko: 2. 수업이나 학사 업무 수행을 방해한 사람

blocks.en: 3. A person who enters university buildings without permission or occupies them
blocks.ko: 3. 학교 건물에 무단 침입하거나 이를 점거한 사람

blocks.en: 4. A person who improperly uses or damages university property, or takes it off campus without permission
blocks.ko: 4. 학교 재산을 부당하게 사용, 손괴하거나 외부에 무단 반출한 사람

blocks.en: 5. A person who improperly uses the university's computers, networks, data, software, etc., or disrupts their operation
blocks.ko: 5. 학교의 컴퓨터·통신망·데이터·소프트웨어 등을 부당하게 사용하거나 그 운용을 방해한 사람

blocks.en: 6. A person who forges or alters university documents or special media records such as electronic records, or uses them dishonestly
blocks.ko: 6. 학교의 문서 또는 전자기록 등 특수매체기록을 위·변조하거나 이를 부정하게 사용한 사람

blocks.en: 7. A person who violates another person's personal rights through verbal or physical violence, harassment, or statements that damage that person's reputation
blocks.ko: 7. 언어적·신체적 폭력과 괴롭힘, 사회적 평가를 저해하는 발언 등으로 타인의 인격권을 침해한 사람

blocks.en: 8. A person who commits sexual harassment, sexual violence, human rights violations or similar acts as defined in Article 2 of the 「Seoul National University Human Rights Center Regulations」
blocks.ko: 8.「서울대학교 인권센터 규정」제2조가 정하는 성희롱·성폭력, 인권침해 등 행위를 범한 사람

blocks.en: 9. A person for whom disciplinary action has been requested under Article 33 of the 「Seoul National University Human Rights Center Regulations」
blocks.ko: 9.「서울대학교 인권센터 규정」제33조에 따른 징계 요청이 있는 사람

blocks.en: 10. A person who violates the University Rules or any other regulations in force at the university
blocks.ko: 10. 학칙 등 본교에서 시행되는 제 규정을 위반한 사람

blocks.en: 11. A person who commits a criminal offense
blocks.ko: 11. 형사상의 범죄를 저지른 사람

blocks.en: 12. A person who otherwise acts in a way that goes against a student's duties
blocks.ko: 12. 그 밖에 학생의 본분에 어긋난 행위를 한 사람

blocks.en: □ Types and cases of misconduct in course registration
blocks.ko: □ 수강신청 관련 부정행위 유형 및 사례

blocks.en: ❍ Logging in to the course registration site with one student account at the same time from several devices (PC and mobile, etc.) or from different web browsers. This overloads the server and takes course seats before other students can.
blocks.ko: ❍ 동일 학생 계정에 여러 접속환경(PC와 모바일 등) 또는 종류가 다른 웹 브라우저에서 수강신청 사이트에 동시 접속하여 서버 부하 유발 및 수강신청 교과목 선점

blocks.en: → Semester 1, 2016: a student of OO College was caught and given a strict warning (disciplinary action if caught again)
blocks.ko: → 2016학년도 1학기, OO대학 소속 학생 적발 및 엄중 경고(차회 적발시 징계)

blocks.en: ❍ Using a program that repeats the same action (commonly called a "macro") to make more registration attempts in the same time than a normal user can. This takes away chances from normal users.
blocks.ko: ❍ 동일 행동 반복 수행 프로그램(통칭 "매크로")을 사용하여 동일 시간 내에 일반적 신청 횟수보다 많은 신청 시도를 함으로써 정상 이용자의 기회 박탈

blocks.en: → Semester 1, 2017: a student of OO College was caught, and the student's course registrations were cancelled
blocks.ko: → 2017학년도 1학기, OO대학 소속 학생 적발 및 수강신청 내역 취소 처리

blocks.en: → Semester 1, 2018: about 30 students were caught, and action was taken, including cancellation of their course registrations
blocks.ko: → 2018학년도 1학기, 30여명 학생 적발 및 수강신청 내역 취소 등 조치 처리

blocks.en: ❍ Harming fairness by using an improper program that can view other students' registrations or take away courses they have registered for
blocks.ko: ❍ 다른 학생의 신청내역을 열람하거나 신청 교과목을 탈획할 수 있는 부적정 프로그램의 사용으로 공정성 침해

blocks.en: → Semester 1, 2016: a student of OO College was caught and suspended from the university for a fixed period (유기정학, fixed-term suspension)
blocks.ko: → 2016학년도 1학기, OO대학 소속 학생 적발 및 유기정학 처리

english: The course registration schedule for the 2026 summer session is announced below. Students who wish to take summer session courses should read the attached files carefully and register according to the schedule.
Printing and payment of the tuition bill

Payment at a bank or by virtual account (a temporary bank account number issued for payment)
If you do not pay, your course registration is automatically cancelled
Before classes start: full tuition refund
Operation of the system to prevent course trading (selling or passing on course seats)

For example, during first-come, first-served course registration and during the registration time for seats freed by cancellations in the course registration change period, you cannot withdraw from courses
(in operation since the 2025 winter session)
Maximum credits you can register for
Up to 9 credits (including credits through credit exchange with other universities in Korea)

Contact the office of the college (graduate school) or department offering the course
▶ For information on the colleges (graduate schools) and departments offering 2026 summer session courses, check the course registration website (http://sugang.snu.ac.kr)
You cannot register for (retake) a course in the summer session if you are currently taking that course in the 1st semester of 2026
Course registration for students expecting to graduate
Check in advance whether you meet the graduation requirements, and be sure to complete your course registration within the period
Over-quota registration (requests to join a course beyond its capacity) and course withdrawal
Make sure you understand the procedures, and you must complete them within the period (no changes are possible after the period)
Any misconduct related to course registration that is discovered will be strictly punished
Attachment 1. 2026 Summer Session Course Registration Guide and Course Registration Manual, 1 copy each
2. Card news (short illustrated guide) on the improved course registration system to prevent course trading, 1 copy
3. Notice on misconduct in course registration, 1 copy
